answer: Use traitor tracing on the work itself. Every task an agent receives is a uniquely watermarked copy, with tiny shifts in numbers and phrasing keyed to that agent, like a vertex label only it holds. When a farm solves one copy and fans the answer out to fifty identities, those answers carry one account's watermark and get linked. Linked accounts collapse to a single seat, and their 30-token bonds go into a vault paid to the auditor. Each fifty-clone island then costs its builder 1,500 tokens and buys only one vote.
